ideas.title: The Impact of Benefits Fraud on Vulnerable Populations in Minnesota
ideas.description: An investigation into the effects of benefits fraud on vulnerable populations in Minnesota, particularly in Somali communities.
ideas.angle: The human impact of benefits fraud and the efforts to combat it
questions: What are the effects of benefits fraud on vulnerable populations?
How are authorities combating benefits fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the human impact of benefits fraud on vulnerable populations in Minnesota, particularly in Somali communities. It would explore the effects of benefits fraud on these communities and the efforts of authorities to combat it.

ideas.title: The Connection Between Benefits Fraud and Childcare Funding
ideas.description: An investigation into the connection between benefits fraud in Minnesota and the Trump administration's freeze of federal childcare funding.
ideas.angle: The connection between benefits fraud and childcare funding
questions: Is there a connection between benefits fraud in Minnesota and the childcare funding freeze?
How do these two issues relate to each other?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the connection between benefits fraud in Minnesota and the Trump administration's freeze of federal childcare funding. It would explore whether there is a link between the two issues and what implications this has for vulnerable populations.
